name: Río Plátano Biosphere Reserve
description: Río Plátano Biosphere Reserve covers about 5,250 square kilometres of northeastern Honduras, where mountain rainforest drops toward the Caribbean coast along the Río Plátano. It protects some of the largest surviving tracts of tropical forest in Central America, home to endangered species and more than 2,000 people who maintain traditional lifeways. Illegal logging, hunting and cattle grazing have put it on the List in Danger since 2011.
